title.zh: 所得税（经济发展与技术开发贷款利息及其他付款豁免）（合并）公告
title.en: Income Tax (Exemption of Interest and Other Payments for Economic and Technological Development Loans) (Consolidation) Notification

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 2 条。

text.en:
Income Tax Act
(Chapter 134, Section 13(4))
Income Tax (Exemption of Interest and Other Payments for Economic and Technological Development Loans) (Consolidation) Notification
N 10
G.N. No. S 24/1996
REVISED EDITION 1997
(15th June 1997)

THE SCHEDULE
First column
Second column
(1) Chartered Semiconductor Manufacturing Pte. Ltd.
Lease Agreements dated 21st July 1995 and 21st August 1995.
(2) Singapore Technologies Pte Ltd.
Deeds of Corporate Guarantee dated 21st July 1995 and 21st August 1995.
[S 76/96 — 16.2.96]
[]
5. Deleted by S 499/2003, wef 05/09/2000.
6.—(1) There shall be exempt from tax interest received from notes issued under the US$300 million Medium Term Note Programme and US$500 million Commercial Paper Programme of Toshiba Capital Asia Ltd by —
(a)any non-resident individual; and
(b)any person, other than an individual, if that person is neither a resident of nor a permanent establishment in Singapore.
(2) The tax exemption is subject to the terms and conditions imposed by the Minister for Finance which were conveyed to Toshiba Capital Asia Ltd by the Monetary Authority of Singapore in its letter dated 5th December 1995.
[S 210/96]
7.—(1) There shall be exempt from tax the interest payable on the US$150 million 7½% Subordinated Notes due 15th March 2006 by The Siam Commercial Bank Public Company Limited to any noteholder who is —
(a)a non-resident individual; or
(b)a person, other than an individual, who is neither a resident of nor a permanent establishment in Singapore.
(2) The exemption is subject to the conditions specified in the Annex to the Ministry of Finance’s letter of approval dated 20th March 1996.
[S 219/96]
8. Any payment made under an interest rate swap transaction in currencies other than Singapore dollars by Cargill Financial Services Asia Pte Ltd to any bank outside Singapore shall be exempt from tax subject to the terms and conditions specified in the letters of approval dated 8th April 1996 and 7th May 1996 issued by the Monetary Authority of Singapore to Cargill Financial Services Asia Pte Ltd.
[S 220/96 wef 01/06/1995]
9.—(1) There shall be exempt from tax the interest payable on the US$75 million Floating Rate Notes due 2001 by Volvo Group Treasury Asia Ltd to any noteholder who is —
(a)a non-resident individual; or
(b)a person, other than an individual, who is neither a resident of nor a permanent establishment in Singapore.
(2) The exemption is subject to the conditions specified in the Annex to the Ministry of Finance’s letter of approval dated 29th March 1996.
[S 396/96]
10.—(1) The interest payable by Petrochemical Corporation of Singapore (Pte) Ltd under the Agreement dated 15th December 1995 shall be exempt from withholding tax from 15th December 1995 to 30th June 2004.
(2) The commitment, agency and front-end/arrangers’ fees payable by Petrochemical Corporation of Singapore (Pte) Ltd in connection with the loan shall also be exempt from withholding tax.
[S 430/96]
11. The interest and fees payable to Banca Di Roma, Houston Agency, US; SunTrust Bank, Atlanta and Citicorp International Ltd, Hong Kong by Tech Semiconductor Singapore Pte Ltd under the Revolving Credit Facility Agreement dated 15th November 1995 shall be exempt from tax from 15th November 1995 to 30th April 2002.
[S 431/96]
12. There shall be exempt from withholding tax from 4th November 1995 to 4th November 1997 the interest payable by Fortune Link Navigation Pte Ltd to The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, Hong Kong, under the Loan Agreement dated 4th November 1995.
[S 432/96]
13. There shall be exempt from withholding tax from 10th November 1995 to 10th November 1999 —
(a)the interest payable by Gloryland Navigation Pte Ltd to The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, Hong Kong, under the Loan Agreement dated 10th November 1995; and
(b)the swap payments made by Gloryland Navigation Pte Ltd to The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, Hong Kong, under the International Swap Dealers Association, Inc. (ISDA) Master Agreement dated 14th November 1995.
[S 433/96]
14. There shall be exempt from withholding tax from 30th November 1994 to 30th November 1999 —
(a)the interest payable by Factors Alpha Shipping (Singapore) Pte Limited to Westpac Asian Lending Pty Limited, Australia, under the Loan Agreement dated 30th November 1994; and
(b)the swap payments made by Factors Alpha Shipping (Singapore) Pte Ltd to Westpac Banking Corporation, Australia, under the International Swap Dealers Association, Inc. (ISDA) Master Agreement dated 7th December 1994.
[S 434/96]
15.—(1) There shall be exempt from tax interest received from notes issued under the US$100 million Italian Lire Short Term Floating Rate Note Programme of Cargill Asia Pacific Treasury Pte Ltd by —
(a)any individual who is not resident in Singapore; and
(b)any person, other than an individual, if that person is neither a resident of nor a permanent establishment in Singapore.
(2) The tax exemption is subject to the terms and conditions specified in the Ministry of Finance’s letter of approval dated 16th October 1996.
[S 537/96]
